documents.text: 2025-06-03 Nordwerk Fahrzeugbau AG (CC-NW-2025-01): Copper cost increase on RD-120. Asked: +2.5% piece price. Outcome: Accepted +1.8% after 3 weeks. Lesson: Nordwerk needs LME evidence plus a cost breakdown per part before they engage

2025-11-14 Brightline Motors Inc. (CC-BL-2024-07): PA66 increase on WH-EV1. Asked: +2.5% piece price. Outcome: Rejected: PA66 is excluded in section 3. Lesson: Brightline only reopens prices through the annual price review; file it before the notice deadline
2025-12-05 Keystone Rubber Co. (VC-2024-040): 2026 price. Asked: Hold 2.10 USD/kg. Outcome: Held flat in exchange for a 12-month volume commitment. Lesson: Keystone trades price for volume certainty
